**Engineered Frontend Solutions for 150K+ Users at NexGen Solutions**  
As a Senior Frontend Engineer at NexGen Solutions, I’ve driven cross-functional initiatives that reduced load times by 40% and scaled React apps to handle 150K+ concurrent users. With 8 years in SaaS, I’ve built scalable architectures that balance performance, accessibility, and maintainability—prioritizing user experience without compromising engineering rigor.  

My work spans full-stack ownership, from REST API design to TypeScript-driven state management, with a focus on measurable outcomes. I’ve led design system implementations that standardized 10+ teams’ UI components, cutting redundancy by 30%, and optimized GraphQL queries to reduce backend latency by 25%. Browser DevTools are my go-to for debugging complex issues, and I’ve leveraged Webpack/Vite to streamline build pipelines, improving deployment efficiency.  

When I’m not mentoring junior engineers on React best practices or advocating for WCAG compliance, I’m exploring ways to merge responsive design with web performance. Let’s connect if you’re tackling similar challenges—collaboration often accelerates innovation.
